item.title: Kim Yong says of Chung Cheong-rae's 'Power is short' remark, "That's an expression that comes from the opposition party" (정청래 ‘정권은 짧다’ 발언에 김용 “야당서 나오는 표현”)
item.description:
Amid growing internal blame games within the Democratic Party of Korea over the results of the June 3 local elections, various interpretations are emerging regarding Representative Chung Cheong-rae's remark at the previous day's party supreme council meeting, where he said, "The people are eternal, and power is short." (6·3 지방선거 결과에 대한 더불어민주당 내 책임 공방이 과열되고 있는 가운데 정청래 대표의 “국민은 영원하고 정권은 짧다”는 전날 당 최고위원회 발언을 놓고 여러 해석이 나오고 있다.)

Former Deputy Director of the Democratic Research Institute Kim Yong, considered a key pro-Moon figure, said on CBS Radio's "Park Sung-tae's News Show" on the 11th, regarding Chung's remark, "It's a highly inappropriate comment, the kind that comes from the opposition party," adding, "If it was intentional, the party leader should clearly take responsibility for (the local election results) and step down—saying power is short while keeping the leadership position is nonsense." (대표적인 ‘친명계’ 인사로 꼽히는 김용 전 민주연구원 부원장은 11일 시비에스(CBS) 라디오 ‘박성태의 뉴스쇼’에서 정 대표의 발언에 대해 “상당히 부적절한 발언으로 야당에서 나오는 표현”이라며 “의도적인 것이라면 당 대표의 (지방선거에 대한) 책임을 분명히 지고 말해야지, 대표직을 유지하면서 정권은 짧다고 하는 것은 어불성설”이고 말했다.)

The previous day, during a blame game over the local election results at the party's supreme council meeting, Chung had said in his concluding remarks, "The people are eternal, and power is short." (전날 지방선거 결과에 대한 책임론을 두고 당 최고위원회에서 공방이 오가자 정 대표는 마무리 발언에서 “국민은 영원하고 정권은 짧다”고 한 바 있다.)

Former Deputy Director Kim said, "In the basic local government head elections, we won 115 seats, while the People Power Party won a whopping 95 seats—it's no exaggeration to say it was a near-total defeat, yet the party is avoiding this issue," adding, "The party is failing to properly read that the president felt that deeply and apologized to the people." He added, "Representative Chung Cheong-rae is not an individual but the party leader, and his responsibility (for the election results) is extremely significant." (김 전 부원장은 “기초자치단체장 선거에서 우리가 115곳, 국민의힘이 무려 95곳을 이겨 거의 완패했다 해도 과언이 아닌데, 당은 이걸 회피하고 있다”며 “대통령이 그런 부분까지 뼈아프게 느끼고 국민들께 사과하신 걸 당이 제대로 읽지 못하고 있다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “정청래 대표는 개인이 아니라 당 대표로, (선거 결과에 대한) 책임이 굉장히 크다”고 덧붙였다.)

Lawmaker Kim Young-jin, often called an 'original pro-Moon figure,' appeared on SBS's "Kim Tae-hyun's Politics Show" on the same day and said of Chung's remark, "It's essentially the same as saying all power comes from the people," but added, "What's needed now is a statement that we need to align the public sentiment and the party sentiment." Kim continued, "Since Representative Chung personally directed the election, there's a need to more specifically and comprehensively evaluate why we lost the Seoul election and discuss what to do," adding, "It's up to party members and the people to judge whether Representative Chung should run for the next party leadership." He further added, "It's not good to divide into pro-Chung and pro-Moon factions. Those preparing for the party leadership must have clear goals for why they want to be party leader, or they will face severe judgment from the public and party sentiment." (‘원조 친명계’로 불리는 김영진 의원은 이날 에스비에스(SBS) ‘김태현의 정치쇼’에 출연해 정 대표의 발언이 “모든 권력은 국민으로부터 나온다는 얘기랑 똑같은 것”이라면서도 “지금은 민심과 당심을 잘 맞춰가는 게 필요하다는 말이 필요하다”고 말했다. 김 의원은 그러면서 “정 대표가 선거를 진두지휘했기 때문에 서울 선거를 진 이유 등을 좀 더 구체적·종합적으로 평가하고, 어떻게 해야 할 것인지를 이야기하는 게 필요하다”며 “정 대표의 다음 당권 출마 여부를 판단하는 것은 당원과 국민이 할 일”이라고 했다. 이어 “친청·친명으로 구분해서 얘기하는 건 좋지 않다. 당권을 준비하는 분들도 자신이 왜 당대표를 하는 것인지 목표를 분명히 하지 않으면 민심과 당심의 엄혹한 평가를 받을 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ruling party reformist group urges Jang Dong-hyuk to step down, opposes nationwide by-elections (국힘 개혁파 모임 “장동혁 물러나라…전국 재선거 반대”)
item.description:
A reformist faction within the People Power Party (PPP), named "Alternatives and Future," publicly called on leader Jang Dong-hyuk to resign on the 11th. (국민의힘 개혁 성향 의원 모임 ‘대안과 미래’가 11일 장동혁 대표 사퇴를 공개적으로 촉구하고 나섰다.)

Lawmakers belonging to the group held a press conference at the National Assembly's Communication Center, stating, "The PPP suffered a crushing defeat in the June 3 local elections," and adding, "Jang's leadership has collapsed, and this is entirely the responsibility of the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership." They emphasized, "Through this election, the public has called for a change in the PPP's leadership. Conservatives have always valued responsibility. If Jang truly considers himself a 'conservative,' he should step down now." (대안과미래 소속 의원들은 이날 국회 소통관에서 기자회견을 열어 “국민의힘은 6·3 지방선거에서 참패했다”며 “장 대표의 리더십은 붕괴됐고, 이는 오롯이 장동혁 지도부의 책임”이라고 말했다. 이어 “국민은 이번 선거를 통해 국민의힘 지도부의 교체를 주문했다. 보수는 늘 책임을 중시해왔다”며 “장 대표가 진정 스스로 ‘보수’라 생각한다면 이제 그만 자리에서 물러나라”고 강조했다.)

They continued, "Jang should not contaminate the infringement of citizens' voting rights due to the shortage of ballot papers with 'election fraud conspiracy theories.' While we fully empathize with the anger of the 2030 generation over the infringement of voting rights caused by the National Election Commission's overall incompetence, we clearly oppose nationwide by-elections." (이들은 “장 대표는 투표용지 부족 사태로 인한 국민의 참정권 침해를 ‘부정선거 음모론’으로 오염시키지 말라”며 “중앙선거관리위원회의 총체적 부실에 따른 참정권 침해 문제 관련해 2030세대의 분노에 적극 공감하지만 전국적인 재선거에 대해선 분명히 반대 입장을 밝힌다”고 했다.)

They added, "Above all, contaminating the demands of citizens who gathered to protect the 'fairness' of elections, the flower of democracy, with 'election fraud conspiracy theories' is something the leader of a conservative party must never do." They further noted, "Jang's unilateral decision to push 'election fraud conspiracy theories' without any consultation or discussion with party lawmakers is an act that denies and damages party democracy." (또한 “무엇보다 민주주의 꽃인 선거의 ‘공정’을 지키고자 모인 시민들의 요구를 ‘부정선거 음모론’으로 오염시키는 것은 보수정당의 대표로 결코 해서는 안 될 행위”라고 말했다. 이들은 아울러 “당 소속 의원들과 아무런 상의도, 토론도 하지 않고 장 대표가 독단적으로 결정해 ‘부정선거 음모론’을 주장하는 행위는 스스로 정당 민주주의를 부정하고 훼손한 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

Regarding the newly elected floor leader, Jeong Jeom-sik, they urged him to "convene a general meeting of lawmakers to gather consensus on Jang's status and the issue of voting rights infringement." (전날 새로 선출된 정점식 원내대표를 향해서는 “장 대표 거취, 참정권 침해 문제에 대한 총의를 모을 의원총회를 소집해달라”고 촉구했다.)

Jang Na-rae, reporter wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: After being attacked for 'election rigging sign', Jang Dong-hyuk says "Does the term matter?… Don't belittle it" (‘부정선거 팻말’ 공격 받자, 장동혁 “용어가 중요한가?…폄훼 말라”)
item.description:
When Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, visited the 'vote-counting site blockade protest' and responded by holding a 'election rigging' hand sign, Kim Yong-tae, a fellow PPP lawmaker, said "the lawmakers were shocked." <<> Appearing on SBS's 'Joo Young-jin's News Briefing' on the 10th, lawmaker Kim responded to a question about whether he had seen the article reporting that "Representative Jang attended the 're-election' rally at Olympic Park, where a crowd increasingly claiming 'election rigging' is gathering, and held an 'election rigging' sign," saying, "Actually, the lawmakers were quite shocked and surprised yesterday." <<> Lawmaker Kim added, "Of course, the lawmakers highly regard the pure 2030 generation's claims for a re-election at Olympic Park and see it as a legitimate right. However, when the party leader asserts 'nationwide re-election' as a personal opinion, and that opinion is introduced not as the party's official stance but as a personal view, it greatly hurts the lawmakers' pride." <<> Lawmaker Kim said, "The party leader is engaging in highly political and irresponsible actions," and added, "Regarding the demand for a nationwide re-election by the party leader, since a new floor leader has been elected, there might be discussions at the general meeting of lawmakers." He continued, "It seems that the party's stance should be formally decided so that we can communicate a responsible position to the citizens and the public." <<> Earlier, on the evening of the 9th, Representative Jang wore a black hat and mask and visited the Olympic Park handball stadium in Songpa-gu, Seoul. Jang held a sign reading 'Election Rigging Re-election Day Voting Manual Recount' and participated in the protest. As the protesters repeatedly chanted slogans like "Election rigging! Re-election! Day voting! Manual recount!", Jang waved a Taegeukgi in sync and stayed with them. Terms like 'day voting' and 'manual recount' are slogans pushed by election fraud conspiracy theorists demanding the abolition of early voting. <<> Park Seong-hoon, PPP spokesperson, responded on the same day to the question, "Representative Jang held an 'election rigging' sign—is that the party's stance?" by saying, "It is difficult to say that the attempt to frame this election as rigged is our party's official position." Park added, "Representative Jang's visit to Olympic Park was as a citizen and a voter, and the party's stance will be determined after the new floor leader listens to lawmakers' opinions through the procedural process of a general meeting. I hope people do not view the People Power Party through a wrong lens." <<> Representative Jang pushed back. When questioned by reporters about attending the protest holding an 'election rigging' sign, Jang said, "Whether you call it election rigging or a flawed election, the revealed facts (about the ballot shortage) do not change," adding, "The current atmosphere of belittling them by focusing on what was written on the sign, as if they are raising conspiracy theories, or trying to dismiss their claims as wrong, is itself irrational." He added, "Does the term matter? Is what's written on the paper important? You can't look at just one thing." <<> At the party's Supreme Council meeting on the 11th, Representative Jang also argued, "Citizens can give many names to the ballot shortage incident," and "The attempt to belittle this incident and reduce its momentum, and to disperse the citizens, by focusing on what name they gave it, is contrary to democracy." <<> Reporter Song Gyeong-hwa freehwa@hani.co.kr (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 ‘개표소 봉쇄 시위’ 현장을 찾아 ‘부정선거’ 손팻말을 들고 호응한 데 대해 김용태 국민의힘 의원은 “의원들이 경악했다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Chung Cheong-rae's Meaningful Remarks: "Politics Is Done by the People… I Agree with President Lee's Evaluation of the Election" (정청래의 의미심장 “정치는 국민이 한다…이 대통령 선거 평가 공감”)
item.description:
Chung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 11th, "We have won when united in history and lost when divided. What we must do now is to gather our resolve and commit to uniting around President Lee Jae-myung, ensuring the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration and achieving a second term." He also introduced President Lee's saying, "Politics may seem like it's done by politicians, but in the end, it is done by the people." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 “우리는 역사 속에서 단결하면 승리했고 분열하면 패배했다”며 “지금 마음을 가다듬고 해야 할 것은 이재명 대통령을 중심으로 뭉쳐 이재명 정부를 성공시키고 반드시 정권 재창출 해야겠다는 다짐과 결의”라고 11일 말했다. 정 대표는 “정치는 정치인이 하는 것 같지만 결국 국민이 한다”는 이 대통령의 어록을 소개하기도 했다.)

During his opening remarks at a general meeting of lawmakers held at the National Assembly's Budget and Accounts Committee meeting room, Chung said, "Regarding the results of the June 3 local elections, I told you yesterday that I agree with President Lee's evaluation." (정 대표는 이날 국회 예결위회의장에서 열린 의원총회 머리발언에서 “6·3 지방선거 결과에 대해 어제 저는 이 대통령님의 평가에 공감한다고 말씀드렸다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

Chung emphasized, "For the success of the Lee Jae-myung government, uniting our efforts and further expanding the democracy we have fought hard to protect is the historical mission of our Democratic Party lawmakers. Before the grand goals of success for the Lee Jae-myung government and achieving a second term, we must prioritize unity first, unity second, and unity third." He also added, "As always, the party, government, and presidential office are one team, one voice." (정 대표는 “이재명 정부 성공을 위해, 우리가 합심 단결하고 어렵게 지켜온 민주주의를 더 확장하는 게 우리 민주당 의원들이 해야 할 역사적 사명”이라며 “이재명 정부 성공과 정권 재창출이라는 대명제 앞에서 우리는 첫째도 단결, 둘째도 단결, 셋째도 단결해야 한다”고 강조했다. 정 대표는 “늘 그래 왔듯이 당·정·청은 원팀, 원보이스”라고도 했다.)

At the start of his remarks, Chung introduced two of President Lee's sayings. He said, "Among President Lee's words, there are two mottos I always keep in my heart. One is 'Politics may seem like it's done by politicians, but in the end, it is done by the people. We must trust only the people and follow only the people.' The other is a frequent saying emphasizing internal unity: 'Would the small differences within us be greater than those of our opponents?'" (이날 정 대표는 머리발언을 시작하며 이 대통령의 어록 두 가지를 소개하기도 했다. 그는 “이 대통령께서 하신 말씀 중에 제가 가슴속에 항상 새기고 있는 어록 두 가지가 있다”며 “하나는 ‘정치는 정치인이 하는 것 같지만 결국 국민이 한다. 국민만 믿고 국민만 보고 가야 한다’는 말씀이었고, 또 하나는 ‘우리 안의 작은 차이가 상대방의 그것보다 크겠느냐’는 우리 내부 단결을 강조하는 말씀을 자주 하셨다”고도 했다.)

Meanwhile, Chung also addressed the 'ballot shortage incident' by the National Election Commission, stating, "Regarding aspects where the flower of democracy—elections—has stirred public distrust and outrage, the National Assembly must take the highest possible measures to respond to the people." (한편 정 대표는 중앙선거관리위원회의 ‘투표용지 부족사태’를 거론하며 “민주주의의 꽃인 선거가 이렇게 국민적 불신과 공분을 불러일으키는 부분에 대해서 국회가 할 수 있는 최고 수위의 조치를 다 해 국민에 응답해야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Go Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee's approval rating drops 9 percentage points… 45% of public says "opposition performed well" in local elections [NBS] (이 대통령 지지율 9%p 하락…국민 45% “선거 야권이 선전” [NBS])
item.description:
According to a public opinion poll, the positive assessment of President Lee Jae-myung's state affairs has fallen by 9 percentage points from three weeks ago. Furthermore, more citizens think the 'opposition performed well' in the June 3 local elections than those who believe the 'ruling party performed well.' (이재명 대통령의 국정운영에 대한 긍정평가가 3주 전보다 9%포인트 하락했다는 여론조사 결과가 나왔다. 또, 6·3 지방선거에서 ‘야권이 선전했다’고 생각하는 국민이 ‘여권이 선전했다’는 국민보다 많은 것으로 나타났다.)

The National Barometer Survey (NBS) results released on the 11th by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research (a telephone interview survey with a sampling error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level) showed that 45% of respondents said 'the opposition, including the People Power Party, performed better than expected' in the local elections, while 31% said 'the ruling party, including the Democratic Party, performed better than expected.' 'Don't know/No response' accounted for 24%. (엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 11일 공개한 전국지표조사(NBS) 결과(전화면접조사, 표본오차는 95% 신뢰수준에 ±3.1%포인트)를 보면, 이번 지방선거 결과에 대해 ‘국민의힘 등 야권이 예상보다 선전했다’는 응답이 45%, ‘더불어민주당 등 여권이 예상보다 선전했다’는 응답은 31%였다. ‘모름·무응답’은 24%였다.)

By supporting party and ideological inclination, the 'opposition performed well' response was high across all groups. Regionally, this response was dominant in all areas except Gwangju/Jeonnam and Busan/Ulsan/Gyeongnam. (지지 정당, 이념 성향별 응답을 보면, 모든 집단에서 ‘야권 선전’ 응답이 높았다. 지역별로는 광주·전남, 부산·울산·경남을 제외하고 모든 지역에서 ‘야권 선전’ 응답이 우세했다.)

President Lee's positive approval rating for state affairs was 57%. This is a 9-percentage-point drop from 66% in the survey three weeks ago. The negative assessment was 33%, up 9 percentage points from 24% three weeks ago. 'Don't know/No response' was 10%. (이 대통령의 국정운영에 대한 긍정평가는 57%였다. 3주 전 조사 때 66%보다 9%포인트 하락한 수치다. 부정평가는 33%로 3주 전 조사(24%)에 견줘 9%포인트 올랐다. 모름·무응답은 10%였다.)

Regarding party support, the Democratic Party stood at 41% and the People Power Party at 25%. The Democratic Party dropped 4 percentage points compared to three weeks ago (45%), while the People Power Party rose 5 percentage points. Following that were the Reform Party at 3%, and both the Fatherland Innovation Party and the Progressive Party at 2% each. The undecided group (no supporting party, don't know/no response) was 24%. item.title: Election Commission: "42,000 Ballot Papers Left in Songpa-gu... Distribution Failure" (선관위 “송파구 투표용지 4만2000장 남아…분배 실패”)
item.description:
The National Election Commission (NEC), which has been criticized for the 'June 3 local election ballot shortage crisis,' explained the background for setting the lower limit of ballot printing ratio at 50%, stating, "There were difficulties in inspecting and storing surplus ballot papers due to the increase in leftover ballots, and printing an excessive number of ballot papers relative to the turnout rate led to suspicions of election fraud." (‘6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태’로 질타를 받고 있는 중앙선거관리위원회가 투표용지 인쇄비율 하한 기준을 50%로 정한 배경에 대해 “잔여 투표용지 증가로 투표용지 검수 및 보관에 어려움이 있었고 투표율 대비 과도한 양의 투표용지를 인쇄하면 부정선거 의혹 제기에 시달렸다”고 밝혔다.)

Wi Cheol-hwan, acting chair of the National Election Commission, issued a statement on the 11th titled "A Message to the People," saying, "Since the public has many questions about the ballot shortage that occurred in this local election, I intend to briefly explain the key points." (위철환 중앙선거관리위원장 직무대행은 11일 입장문 ‘국민 여러분께 올리는 말씀’을 내어 “이번 지방선거에서 발생한 투표용지 부족사태에 대해 국민들께서 몹시 궁금한 사항이 많은 상황이므로 핵심 사항을 간략하게 설명드리고자 한다”며 이렇게 밝혔다.)

Acting Chair Wi stated, "You may wonder how the 50% lower limit for printing main election ballot papers was decided. After the last election, the number of leftover ballot papers increased, making it difficult to inspect and store millions of ballots, and there were also concerns about loss, theft, or seizure. In particular, printing an excessive amount of ballot papers relative to the turnout rate on election day led to accusations of election fraud." He added, "We have received on-site requests for lowering the lower limit in areas where early voting rates have increased and main election turnout has decreased, as well as difficulties in securing printing facilities due to the short printing period." (위 직무대행은 “본투표용지 인쇄 비율 50% 하한 기준이 어떻게 결정되었는지 궁금하실 것”이라며 “지난 선거 후 잔여 투표용지가 증가해 수백만장의 투표용지에 대한 검수 및 보관상의 어려움이 있었고 분실, 도난 및 탈취의 우려 또한 있었다. 특히, 선거일 투표율 대비 과도한 양의 투표용지 인쇄 시 부정선거 의혹 제기에 시달렸다”고 했다. 이어 위 직무대행은 “사전투표율이 증가하고 본투표율이 감소한 지역에서의 하한선 인하 필요성, 짧은 인쇄 기간으로 투표용지 인쇄소 확보 어려움 등을 현장에서 호소해 왔다”고도 했다.)

On December 10 of last year, the NEC, under the authority of the Secretary-General, revised the comprehensive management guidelines for the 9th nationwide local elections, stating, "The number of ballot papers to be printed for election day can be adjusted to a standard of 50% (lower limit) of the electorate through a committee resolution if the need to reduce printing is recognized, considering the expected early voting rate and recent election turnout rates." Accordingly, the lower limit for the number of printed ballot papers was reduced from the previous 60% to 50%. (중앙선관위는 지난해 12월10일 사무총장 전결로 “선거일 투표용지 인쇄매수는 예상 사전투표율 및 최근 선거의 투표율 등을 감안하여 축소인쇄 필요성이 인정되는 경우 위원회 의결로 선거인수 50%(하한)를 기준으로 조정 가능하다”는 제9회 전국동시지방선거 종합관리지침 등을 개정했다. 이에 따라 투표용지 인쇄매수 하한은 기존 60%에서 50%로 줄었다.)

Acting Chair Wi further noted, "Considering local circumstances and characteristics, the printing ratio of ballot papers was decided by the 255 district, city, and county election commissions. Some places actually set the main election printing ratio at 50%, while the Ongjin County Election Commission decided on 100%." (위 직무대행은 또 “지역 사정과 특성을 고려해 255개 구·시·군 선관위의 결정으로 투표용지 인쇄비율을 결정하도록 했다”며 “실제로 본투표 인쇄비율을 50%로 결정한 곳도 있고 옹진군 선관위의 경우 100%로 결정하기도 했다”고 덧붙였다.)

Additionally, Acting Chair Wi explained that the cause of the ballot shortage in Songpa-gu was a failure in ballot distribution. He said, "The 50% printing ratio for main election ballot papers excludes the 23.3% early voting rate, so the overall printing ratio is 73.3%." He continued, "Songpa-gu has a total of 565,368 eligible voters, and its overall turnout rate was 65.8%, meaning that across the entire district, over 42,000 ballot papers were left over. However, the painful mistake was the failure to distribute ballot papers properly to the 146 polling stations within Songpa-gu." (아울러 위 직무대행은 송파구 투표용지 부족사태 발생 원인은 투표용지 분배 실패 때문이었다고 설명했다. 위 직무대행은 “본투표용지 인쇄비율 50%는 사전투표율 23.3%를 제외한 개념으로 전체 투표인쇄비율은 73.3%”이라 했다. 그러면서 “송파구의 총 유권자수는 56만5368명이고 송파구의 전체 투표율은 65.8%이므로 실제 송파구 전체로 보면 투표용지가 4만2000여 매가 남았다. 그런데 송파구 내 146개 투표소별 투표용지 분배에 실패한 것이 뼈아픈 실수였다”고 했다.)

Acting Chair Wi stated, "A fact-finding committee composed of external members is rigorously investigating the ballot shortage, and it is expected that the truth will be revealed in detail through investigations by the prosecution and the National Assembly's parliamentary inquiry. However, since time is required until then and public curiosity is growing by the day, I have reported what I currently know." (위 직무대행은 “외부인으로 구성된 진상규명위원회에서 엄정하게 (투표용지 부족사태를) 조사 중이고, 수사기관의 수사와 국회 국정조사에서 그 진상이 자세하게 밝혀질 것으로 예상한다”며 “그러나 그때까지 시간이 소요되고 국민 여러분의 궁금증은 날로 증폭돼 현재까지 제가 알고 있는 내용을 보고드리게 됐다”고 했다.)

Acting Chair Wi, who was a standing commissioner of the NEC, has been serving as acting chair since the 8th, following the resignation of NEC Chair Noh Tae-ak and the notification of his dismissal by the Supreme Court. (중앙선관위 상임위원이었던 위 직무대행은 노태악 중앙선관위원장 사퇴 및 대법원 지명 해제 통보에 따라 지난 8일부터 중앙선관위원장 직무를 대행하고 있다.)

Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Park Ji-won: "The President's Will is 'Jung Cheong-rae, Step Down'... Leadership Should Resign En Masse" (박지원 “‘정청래 나가라’는 게 대통령 뜻…지도부 총사퇴해야”)
item.description:
Park Ji-won, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, publicly called for Jung Cheong-rae, the party's leader, to step down from his position. (박지원 더불어민주당 의원이 정청래 민주당 대표가 대표직에서 물러날 것을 공개적으로 촉구했다.)

In an interview with MBC's 'Kwon Soon-pyo's News High Kick' on the 10th, lawmaker Park stated, "The president has already spoken," adding, "We lost with the Seoul mayoral election, and while we won arithmetically, we suffered a political defeat, leaving us feeling empty. If that was said, then Jung Cheong-rae and the rest of the Democratic Party leadership should understand the president's intention behind 'planting a phoenix tree'." (박 의원은 10일 문화방송(MBC) ‘권순표의 뉴스하이킥’과의 인터뷰에서 “이미 대통령이 말했다”며 “서울시장을 이래가지고(패배해서) 우리가 산술적으로는 승리했지만 정치적 패배를 해서 허탈한데, 그렇게 말했으면 정청래 대표 등 민주당 지도부가 대통령의 ‘벽오동 심은 뜻’을 알아야 한다”고 말했다.)

Previously, on the 8th, during a press conference marking his first year in office, President Lee evaluated the results of the June 3 local elections, saying, "It's a warning from the people," and "It's not a success, at the very least." (앞서 이 대통령은 지난 8일 취임 1주년 기자회견에서 6·3 지방선거 결과에 대해 “국민들이 주는 경고”라며 “최소한 성공은 아니다”라고 평가한 바 있다.)

When asked by the host, "What is the meaning of 'planting a phoenix tree'?", lawmaker Park bluntly replied, "(Representative Jung) should step down." He continued, "Take responsibility and step down. When a phoenix tree leaf falls, you should know that autumn has arrived, but to think this way after the leaf has fallen is very bad." He added, "Of course, Representative Jung has many achievements, such as dealing with the impeachment, dismantling the insurrection, and the three major reforms, but even if you've done well, it's still a hundred achievements and one mistake." Park emphasized, "If a politician makes one mistake, the people hold them accountable. I urge Representative Jung and the leadership to resign en masse, take responsibility, and declare that they will not run in the party convention." (박 의원은 “‘벽오동 심은 뜻’이 뭐냐”는 진행자의 질문에 “(정 대표가) ‘나가라’다”라고 잘라 말했다. 이어 “책임지고 나가라. 그리고 오동잎 떨어지면 가을이 온 것을 알아야지, 오동잎 떨어졌는데 이런 생각을 하는 건 아주 나쁘다”고 했다. 또 “물론 정 대표가 탄핵, 내란 청산, 3대 개혁 등 업적이 많다”면서도 “잘했어도 백공일과다”라고 말했다. 박 의원은 “정치인은 한 가지 잘못하면 국민은 책임을 묻는 것”이라며 “정 대표 등 지도부가 총사퇴하고, 책임을 지고 (전당대회에) 불출마 선언을 하라고 촉구한다”고 강조했다.)

Park also said, "Even if the KOSPI index is good, the livelihood of ordinary people is difficult. If we don't successfully dismantle the insurrection and carry out the three major reforms, we'll end up in a world where Lee Myung-bak, Park Geun-hye, and Yoon Seok-youl's version of 're-ゲイン' (re-gain) will emerge, and the Democratic Party is paving the way for that." (박 의원은 “코스피는 좋아도 서민 경제는 어렵다”며 “내란 청산, 3대 개혁을 성공적으로 하지 않으면 또다시 이명박, 박근혜, 윤어게인이 나오는 세상이 된다고 했는데 그 길로 민주당이 아스팔트 깔아준다”고도 했다.)

item.title: Government: "Fukushima Nuclear Plant Alarm Triggers Automatic Halt of Treated Water Discharge"... Investigating Cause (정부 “후쿠시마 원전, 경보 울려 오염수 방류 자동정지”…원인 조사중)
item.description:
Japan's Tokyo Electric Power Company (TEPCO) experienced an alarm during the discharge of radioactive treated water from the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant, leading to an automatic halt of the release, the Office for Government Policy Coordination (OPC) said on the 11th. (일본 도쿄전력이 후쿠시마 원자력발전소 방사능 오염수를 방류하던 중 경보가 울려 방류가 자동 정지됐다고 국무조정실이 11일 밝혔다.)

Kim Young-soo, First Deputy Director of the OPC, stated in a written briefing on the 11th: "Yesterday (the 10th), through Korea-Japan diplomatic and regulatory channels, we were immediately informed that during TEPCO's 20th discharge of treated water, an alarm went off in the transfer process, automatically stopping the release at around 4:17 PM on the 10th." He added, "TEPCO inspected the site and reported that there is no abnormality in the transfer equipment at present and that they are investigating the cause of the alarm." He continued, "The government is continuously monitoring the situation at the Fukushima nuclear plant. If further information, such as the cause of the alarm, is identified, we will provide updates later." (김영수 국무조정실 국무1차장은 11일 서면 브리핑을 통해 “어제(10일) 한-일 외교·규제 채널을 통해 도쿄전력의 오염수 20차 방류 과정에서 이송 공정 경보 발생으로 10일 오후 4시 17분께 방류가 자동 정지된 상황을 즉시 공유받았다”고 밝혔다. 그는 “도쿄전력이 현장 상황을 점검한 결과 현재 이송 설비에는 이상이 없고, 경보 발생 원인에 대해 조사중이라고 밝혔다”고 전했다. 이어 “정부는 후쿠시마 원전 현지 상황을 지속적으로 모니터링하고 있으며, 경보 발생 원인 등 추가적인 정보가 파악되는 경우, 추후 설명드리겠다”고 했다.)

TEPCO began discharging treated water from Fukushima in August 2023, and this was the 20th discharge operation. This time, approximately 7,800 tons of treated water are being diluted with seawater and released into the ocean from the 1st to the 19th. According to Japan's Kyodo News, this is the sixth time the discharge has been halted mid-operation since TEPCO began the treated water release process. (도쿄전력은 지난 2023년 8월 후쿠시마 오염수를 방류하기 시작했으며, 이번이 20번째 방류 작업이었다. 이번에는 지난 1일부터 오는 19일까지 오염수 약 7800t을 바닷물로 희석해 바다로 방류하게 된다. 도쿄전력이 오염수 방류 작업을 시작한 이후 도중에 중단된 것은 이번이 6번째라고 일본 교도통신은 전했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "The 'Security from the US, Economy from China' Approach Has Lost Its Validity" (이 대통령 “안미경중 방식은 유효성 잃어”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, who is on a state visit to Italy, said on the 11th (local time), "South Korean diplomacy has so far been defined by the framework of 'security from the US, economy from China' (anmi-gyeongjung), but amid recent geopolitical changes, I believe the existing dichotomous approach has lost its validity." (이탈리아를 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 11일(현지시각) “한국 외교는 그간 ‘안미경중’(안보는 미국, 경제는 중국)이라는 틀로 규정됐으나 최근의 지정학적 환경 변화 가운데 기존의 이분법적 접근 방식은 유효성을 잃었다고 본다”고 말했다.)

In an interview with the Italian daily 'Corriere della Sera' published on this day, President Lee stated, "Rather than trying to maintain a balance between the US and China, South Korea seeks to explore a new approach under a multifaceted perception based on our national interests, according to factors of competition, cooperation, and challenges." ( 이 대통령은 이날 공개된 이탈리아 일간지 ‘꼬리에레델라 세라’와 인터뷰에서 “한국은 미·중 사이에서 균형을 유지하려 한다기보다는 우리 국익에 기반해 경쟁·협력·도전 요인에 따라 다각적인 인식 하에 새로운 접근 방식을 모색해 나가고자 한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee further said, "China is South Korea's largest trading partner and an essential supply chain partner. However, on the other hand, it is true that the competitive aspect between the two countries has also grown, because China's industrial competitiveness and advanced technology have been upgraded." He added, "At this point, expanding economic cooperation with the US into high-tech fields is a factor that helps strengthen our industrial competitiveness and advance our economy." This is interpreted as reaffirming a pragmatic diplomatic stance that prioritizes national interests—pursuing cooperation and competition on a case-by-case basis—rather than choosing between the US and China. ( 그러면서 이 대통령은 “중국은 한국의 최대 교역국이자 필수적인 공급망 파트너”라며 “그러나 한편으로는 양국의 경쟁 측면도 커진 게 사실이다. 중국의 산업 경쟁력과 첨단 기술이 고도화됐기 때문”이라고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “이 시점에서 미국과의 경제협력이 첨단 분야로 확대되는 것은 우리 산업 경쟁력 강화 및 경제 고도화에 도움이 되는 요소”라고 덧붙였다. 미·중 가운데 어느 한쪽을 선택하기보다 국익을 기준으로 사안별 협력과 경쟁을 병행하는 실용외교 기조를 재확인한 것으로 풀이된다.)

President Lee also emphasized the South Korea-US alliance but stressed becoming a capable partner responsible for its own security, rather than a dependent ally. He said, "While the alliance with the US remains a fundamental axis of South Korean diplomacy, we aim to pursue a strategy of deepening and evolving the alliance to suit the times and reality, while simultaneously strengthening self-reliance and revitalizing solidarity with various countries." He noted, "This is also in line with what the US wants from the alliance. To this end, the South Korean government is pushing for the recovery of wartime operational control (OPCON) over our military and increasing defense spending." The South Korean government has set a target of transferring OPCON by 2027. ( 또 한미 동맹을 강조하면서도 의존적 동맹국이 아니라 스스로 안보를 책임지는 능력 있는 파트너가 되겠다고 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “미국과의 동맹은 여전히 한국 외교의 기본 축이나 시대와 현실에 맞게 동맹을 심화·발전시키는 동시에 자강을 공고히 하고 다양한 국가들과의 연대를 활성화하는 전략을 추진하고자 한다”며 “이는 미국이 원하는 동맹의 방향과도 일맥상통한다. 이를 위해 한국 정부는 우리 군에 대한 전시작전통제권 회복과 국방비 증액 등을 추진해 나가고 있다”고 말했다. 우리 정부는 2027년까지 전작권 전환을 목표로 하고 있다.)

Rome/Correspondent Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 로마/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President's approval rating plummets to 9% repeatedly..."Impact of election setbacks and ruling party conflicts" (이 대통령 지지율 잇따라 9%p대 급락…“선거 부진·여권 갈등 영향”)
item.description:
Following the June 3 local elections, opinion polls are emerging one after another showing a decline in positive assessments of President Lee Jae-myung's state affairs management. (6·3 지방선거 뒤 이재명 대통령의 국정 운영에 대한 긍정 평가가 하락했다는 여론조사가 잇따라 나오고 있다.)

According to the National Barometer Survey (NBS) results released on the 11th by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research (conducted from the 8th to the 10th targeting 1,001 individuals aged 18 and older via telephone interviews, with a margin of error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level), the positive evaluation of President Lee's state affairs management was 57%. The negative evaluation stating he is "doing poorly" was 33%. Compared to the previous survey conducted on May 18-20 (3rd week of May), the positive evaluation dropped by 9 percentage points, while the negative evaluation rose by 9 percentage points. This marks the first time President Lee's approval rating has fallen below 60% since the 4th week of January survey (59%). <<> A representative from Hankook Research told The Hankyoreh, "These local elections served as a midterm evaluation of the president," adding, "The unexpectedly poor election results, coupled with signs of conflict within the ruling party afterward, appear to have influenced the evaluation of the president's state affairs management." Earlier, in a mobile automated response (ARS) survey conducted by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI) on the 8th and 9th, President Lee's approval rating for state affairs plummeted by 9.4 percentage points compared to the previous survey (4th week of May), recording 50.4%. <<> In the National Barometer Survey, regarding the results of these local elections, 45% of respondents said "the opposition, including the People Power Party, performed better than expected," while 31% said "the ruling party, including the Democratic Party of Korea, performed better than expected." "Don't know or no response" accounted for 24%. <<> In terms of party support, the Democratic Party of Korea received 41%, and the People Power Party received 25%. The Democratic Party saw a 4 percentage point decrease compared to three weeks ago, while the People Power Party increased by 5 percentage points. In Seoul, in particular, support rates for the Democratic Party and the People Power Party were 30% and 31% respectively, effectively tied. For more details, refer to the website of the Central Election Poll Review Committee. <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr (엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 11일 공개한 전국지표조사(NBS) 결과(지난 8~10일 만 18살 이상 1001명 대상 전화면접조사, 표본오차는 95% 신뢰수준에 ±3.1%포인트)를 보면, 이 대통령의 국정 운영에 대해 ‘잘하고 있다’는 긍정 평가가 57%로 집계됐다. ‘잘 못하고 있다’는 부정 평가는 33%였다. 이는 지난달 18~20일(5월 3주차)에 실시된 직전 조사와 비교해 긍정 평가는 9%포인트 내려가고, 부정 평가는 9%포인트 오른 수치다. 이 대통령의 국정 지지도가 60% 아래로 내려간 것은 지난 1월 4주차 조사(59%) 이후 처음이다.)

item.title: "Party Contaminated by Election Fraud Claims" – Calls for Resignation Erupt… Jang Dong-hyuk Holds His Ground (“부정선거에 당 오염” 사퇴론 분출…장동혁은 ‘버티기’)
item.description:
Within the People Power Party, demands are erupting one after another for party leader Jang Dong-hyuk and the leadership to resign en masse, taking responsibility for the defeat in the June 3 local elections. However, Jang is showing signs of entrenchment, insisting that "nothing is more important right now than the shortage of ballot papers in South Korea," raising the prospect of escalating internal conflict. <<> Woo Jae-jun, a senior youth committee member of the People Power Party, said in an open statement during the party's Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly on the 11th, "I wish we would all resign," adding, "I hope we can open the way for the next leadership." He continued, "We should hold another national convention, and Chairman Jang should run again in a by-election to be re-evaluated. Only then can party members with grievances accept the outcome, and we can unite and move forward together." Woo is classified as a pro-Han Dong-hoon faction member. <<> Pro-leadership Supreme Council members immediately moved to shield Chairman Jang. Cho Gwang-han, a close aide to Jang and a Supreme Council member, directly struck back, saying, "Making such immature remarks publicly is extremely politically inexperienced," prompting Woo to retort, "Immature remarks, you say?" The atmosphere in the meeting froze instantly. Then, Kim Min-soo, a Supreme Council member aligned with Jang, seized the microphone and launched an offensive, saying, "You should discuss matters like that in closed-door meetings," and "Why would someone who has never properly attended a single closed-door meeting come here to champion not the party, but a personal faction?" <<> In response, Chairman Jang stated, "Right now, nothing is more important in South Korea than this shortage of ballot papers. Whether ruling or opposition, the political sphere must resolve this issue." He added, "If we shift focus to that issue (the call for leadership resignation), our party will ultimately become buried in internal strife." He said, "If you demand any choices from or want to open a path for the party leadership, the 110 lawmakers (of the People Power Party) must first provide an answer on how to resolve this situation." This made it clear that he had no intention of resigning. <<> Immediately after the chaotic Supreme Council meeting, members of the Alternative and Future, a group of reform-minded lawmakers within the party, also pressured Jang over his position. They urged him to resign, stating, "Chairman Jang's leadership has collapsed, and this is entirely the responsibility of Jang Dong-hyuk's leadership." They further argued, "Chairman Jang must not contaminate the infringement of the people's right to vote caused by the ballot paper shortage with 'election fraud conspiracy theories,'" and "We clearly oppose the nationwide re-election (that Chairman Jang advocates)." They demanded that new floor leader Jung Jeom-sik convene a general assembly of lawmakers to build consensus on Chairman Jang's position and the issue of the infringement of voting rights. <<> The calls for Jang's resignation align with internal concerns over election fraud theories. There are successive criticisms that he is using the ballot paper shortage as a shield to preserve his position while even jumping on the bandwagon of election fraud claims. A two-term lawmaker told *The Hankyoreh* that day, "It was only a matter of time before Chairman Jang stepped down anyway, but if he had only talked about the infringement of voting rights, it would have been difficult to immediately demand his resignation," adding, "By contaminating (the party) with election fraud conspiracy theories, he has dug his own grave. The demands for Chairman Jang to resign are inevitably going to intensify further." <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (국민의힘에서 6·3 지방선거 패배의 책임을 지고 장동혁 대표 등 지도부가 총사퇴해야 한다는 주장이 잇달아 분출되고 있다. 그러나 장 대표는 “지금 대한민국에서 투표용지 부족 사태보다 중요한 것은 없다”며 버티기에 나서면서 당내 갈등이 고조될 조짐이다.)

item.title: Parliamentary Report on 'Ballot Shortage' National Audit Request... Negotiations on Investigation Period and Scope Begin (‘투표지 부족’ 국조요구서 본회의 보고…조사 기간·내용 협상 돌입)
item.description:
A request for a parliamentary investigation into the 'ballot shortage incident' that occurred during the June 3 local elections was reported to the National Assembly plenary session on the 11th. Negotiations between the ruling and opposition parties over the details of the investigation have also begun in earnest. (6·3 지방선거에서 벌어진 ‘투표용지 부족사태’를 다루는 국정조사 요구서가 11일 국회 본회의에 보고됐다. 국정조사의 세부 내용을 둘러싼 여야 협상도 본격화됐다.)

On this day, parliamentary investigation requests signed by lawmakers from both the Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party were submitted and reported to the plenary session. Under the rules, once a parliamentary investigation request is submitted, the National Assembly Speaker must report it to the plenary session without delay. Following this, the Speaker will consult with both parties to form a special committee on the parliamentary investigation, prepare an investigation plan detailing the period, purpose, and scope of the investigation, and proceed with a plenary vote. (이날 국회 본회의에는 더불어민주당과 국민의힘 양당 소속 의원이 모두 이름을 올린 국정조사 요구서가 각각 제출돼 보고됐다. 국회의장은 국정조사요구서가 제출되면 지체없이 본회의에 보고하게 돼 있다. 국회의장은 이후 양당과 협의해 국정조사 특별위원회를 구성하고 조사기간과 목적, 조사 범위 등을 기재한 조사 계획서를 마련해 본회의 의결 절차를 거치게 된다.)

National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik, during a meeting with floor leaders Park Chan-dae (Democratic Party) and Kweon Seong-dong (People Power Party), urged them to "swiftly form the special committee on the parliamentary investigation and process the investigation plan at next week's plenary session, actively working together to uncover the truth as soon as possible." After the closed-door meeting, Jang Hyun-joo, the Speaker's senior secretary for public communication and coordination, told reporters, "The Speaker proposed scheduling next week's plenary session to form the special committee on the parliamentary investigation and discuss the investigation plan, and both floor leaders agreed with this intention." (조정식 국회의장은 이날 한병도 민주당·정점식 국민의힘 원내대표와 회동한 자리에서 “신속하게 국정조사특별위원회를 구성하고 다음 주 본회의에서 국정조사계획서를 처리해 하루라도 빨리 진상규명에 나설 수 있도록 적극 힘을 모아달라”고 당부했다. 비공개 회동 이후 장현주 국회의장 공보소통수석은 기자들과 만나 “조 의장은 다음 주 본회의 일정을 잡아 국정조사 관련 특위도 구성하고 국정조사 계획서를 협의하자는 제안을 하셨고 양당 원내대표도 그 취지에 공감했다”고 말했다.)

The Democratic Party and the People Power Party have begun specific negotiations over the period and content of the parliamentary investigation. The Democratic Party plans to conduct negotiations with the goal of passing the investigation plan on the 18th. However, opinions differ on the scope of the investigation and the composition of the special committee. Both the Democratic Party and the People Power Party have claimed the chairmanship of the special committee. The Democratic Party insists that the special committee should be formed based on the proportion of seats in the National Assembly, while the People Power Party is pushing for an equal number of members from both parties. (민주당과 국민의힘은 국정조사 기간과 조사 내용 등을 둘러싼 구체적인 협상에 들어갔다. 민주당은 오는 18일 국정조사계획서 의결을 목표로 협상을 진행한다는 계획이다. 다만 조사 범위나 특위 구성에 입장이 엇갈린다. 민주당과 국민의힘 모두 특위 위원장을 맡겠다고 주장했다. 민주당은 국회 의석 비율에 따라 특위를 구성해야 한다는 입장이지만, 국민의힘은 여야 동수를 고집하고 있다.)

According to a National Indicator Survey (NBS) conducted from the 8th to the 10th by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research on 1,001 men and women aged 18 and over nationwide, 85% of respondents said a parliamentary investigation was necessary regarding the ballot shortage at some polling stations. Only 11% said it was not necessary. (이날 엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 지난 8일부터 10일까지 전국 만 18세 이상 남녀 1001명을 대상으로 실시한 전국지표조사(NBS) 결과, 일부 투표소에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해서는 응답자의 85%가 국정조사가 필요하다고 답했다. 필요하지 않다는 응답은 11%였다.)

Go Han-sol, Go Gyeong-ju reporters sol@hani.co.kr (고한솔 고경주 기자 sol@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee at Korea-EU Summit: "Strongly Requested Favorable Consideration of Steel Duty-Free Quotas" (이 대통령, 한-EU 정상회담서 “철강 무관세 쿼터 우호적 고려 강력 요청”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung at the Korea-European Union (EU) summit held in Brussels, Belgium on the 10th (local time) "strongly requested favorable consideration for South Korea, an FTA signatory and strategic partner, in order to secure as many steel duty-free quotas as possible," the presidential office announced. <<> Kim Yong-beom, head of the presidential office's policy office, said at a briefing held at a press center set up in Rome, Italy on the 11th, "Following the guidelines from the Korea-EU summit leaders, the trade chief and the EU conducted intensive negotiations on quota volumes, achieving maximum progress," adding, "A favorable outcome compared to other countries is expected." <<> The EU had previously announced plans starting next month to cut duty-free import quotas in half under the Tariff-Rate Quota (TRQ) system and impose a 50% tariff on imports exceeding the allocated volume. <<> President Lee addressed the EU's steel tariff imposition as a major agenda item in his summit meeting the previous day with António Costa, President of the European Council, and Ursula von der Leyen, President of the European Commission. Director Kim stated, "These negotiations were challenging due to the very limited time before the new system takes effect on July 1, but it served as a good opportunity to raise the issue at the highest level." He added, "President Lee explained the importance of bilateral relations at the Korea-EU summit and requested attention to ensure Korean companies do not face unfair disadvantages on steel issues." <<> He further said, "We explained that this could have broad impacts on industrial cooperation and supply chain stability, and stressed that results befitting a mutually beneficial economic relationship should be reached." Director Kim reported that the EU side responded by saying, "As a country sharing common values and a partner nation, we will consider South Korea as favorably as possible." <<> Rome/Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 지난 10일(현지시각) 벨기에 브뤼셀에서 열린 한-유럽연합(EU) 정상회담에서 “철강 무관세 쿼터를 최대한 확보하기 위해 자유무역협정(FTA) 체결국이자 전략적 파트너인 한국에 대한 우호적 고려를 강력히 요청했다”고 청와대가 밝혔다.)

item.title: Government to explain record 624.6 billion won fine on Coupang to U.S. government (정부, 쿠팡 6246억 과징금 관련 “미국 정부에 설명할 것”)
item.description:
After the Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC) decided on the 11th to impose a fine of 624.681 billion won on Coupang for personal information leakage and infringement incidents, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated that it "plans to explain the relevant details to the U.S. government." As Coupang has mobilized its full lobbying power with the U.S. government and Congress to pressure the South Korean government, attention is focused on the U.S. government's reaction to the "largest-ever" fine. (11일 개인정보보호위원회(개인정보위)가 개인정보 유출 및 침해 사고를 일으킨 쿠팡에 과징금 6246억8100만원의 과징금 등을 부과하기로 결정한 것과 관련해, 외교부는 “미국 정부에 관련 내용을 설명할 계획”이라고 밝혔다. 쿠팡이 미 정부와 의회에 로비력을 총동원해 한국 정부를 압박했던만큼, ‘역대 최대 규모’의 과징금 처분에 대한 미 정부의 반응이 주목된다.)

A foreign ministry official, meeting with reporters on the same day, said, "The non-discrimination policy, including towards U.S. digital companies like Coupang, is also included in the joint fact sheet agreed upon by the South Korea-U.S. summit," and added, "We will calmly explain the results of the PIPC's measures regarding Coupang to the U.S. side while maintaining the non-discrimination policy." The official also stated, "It is understood that the PIPC conducted the investigation fairly in accordance with procedures set by domestic law, under the principle of imposing measures commensurate with responsibility, and gave Coupang sufficient opportunity to present its opinions during the investigation process." The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is expected to explain the details and background of the PIPC's decision to the U.S. State Department. (외교부 당국자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “쿠팡을 포함한 미국 디지털 기업에 대한 비차별 정책과 관련한 내용이 한미 정상 합의사항인 조인트팩트시트(공동설명자료)에도 담겨 있다”며 “비차별 정책을 견지하면서 쿠팡에 대한 (개인정보위의) 처분 결과를 미국 쪽에 차분하게 설명할 것”이라고 말했다. 이 당국자는 “개인정보위가 책임에 상응하는 처분을 부과한다는 원칙 하에 국내법에서 정한 절차에 따라 공정하게 조사를 진행했고, 조사 과정에서 쿠팡이 충분히 의견을 개진할 수 있도록 기회를 부여한 것으로 안다”고 말했다. 외교부는 미 국무부에 개인정보위 결정의 내용과 배경을 설명할 것으로 보인다.)

Previously, on this day, the PIPC imposed a total fine of 624.681 billion won and a penalty of 16.8 million won on Coupang for reasons including leaking the personal information of 37.55 million members and non-members, and illegally collecting online activity records of approximately 1.17 million members without legal basis. (앞서, 개인정보위는 이날 쿠팡이 회원과 비회원 3755만명의 개인정보를 유출하고, 법적 근거 없이 회원 117만여명의 온라인 활동 기록을 무단으로 수집했다는 사유 등으로 모두 6246억8100만원의 과징금과 1680만원의 과태료를 부과했다.)

Under the Trump administration, the U.S. has increasingly tended to view regulations on its own digital companies as non-tariff trade barriers. Moreover, Coupang has been pressuring the South Korean government for months by mobilizing government officials and politicians through comprehensive lobbying of the White House, State Department, and Congress. Last January, when Prime Minister Kim Min-seok met U.S. Vice President JD Vance in Washington, Vice President Vance even directly mentioned the Coupang issue. (미국은 트럼프 행정부에 들어 자국 디지털 기업에 대한 규제를 비관세 무역 장벽으로 보는 경향이 더 커졌다. 게다가 쿠팡은 백악관과 국무부, 의회에 대한 전방위적 로비로 정부 관료와 정치인들을 움직여 수개월간 한국 정부에 압박을 가해왔다. 지난 1월 김민석 국무총리가 워싱턴에서 제이디 밴스 미국 부통령을 만났을 때 밴스 부통령이 쿠팡 문제를 직접 언급할 정도였다.)

It has been pointed out that U.S. dissatisfaction with the Coupang issue contributed to delays in tariff negotiations, as well as security negotiations on nuclear power and nuclear-powered submarines, at the beginning of the year for several months. South Korea and the U.S. rekindled discussions during their first security negotiations on the 2nd and 3rd, building a consensus to carefully manage external factors like the Coupang issue so they do not hinder negotiations. (관세협상 과정은 물론, 원자력·핵추진잠수함 등 안보협상이 연초부터 수개월간 지연된 데에도 쿠팡 문제에 대한 미국의 불만이 작용했다는 지적도 나왔다. 한-미는 지난 2∼3일 첫 안보협상을 하며 논의의 불씨를 살렸고, 쿠팡 문제와 같은 외부 요인이 협상에 지장을 주지 않도록 잘 관리해 나가자는 공감대도 쌓은 상황이다.)

However, given the unpredictable nature of the Trump administration and the reactions of U.S. lawmakers who have dealt with the Coupang issue, there is a high possibility of renewed pressure following this fine. On the same day, the U.S. global digital news platform 'Semafor' reported in an article titled "Trump allies stoke conflict over Coupang in South Korea" that Republican figures are stepping in to defend Coupang. Citing a source familiar with the Coupang matter, the outlet also reported, "USTR Representative Jamieson Greer is personally working to find a way to address Coupang's concerns." It also reported that as Coupang began utilizing a network of pro-Trump MAGA lobbyists, voices calling to support Coupang in the U.S. have grown louder. (하지만 불확실성이 큰 트럼프 행정부의 특성과 그간 쿠팡 문제를 다뤄온 미 의원들의 반응 등을 고려하면, 이번 과징금 부과를 계기로 다시 압박을 이어갈 가능성이 크다. 미국 글로벌 디지털 뉴스플랫폼 ‘세마포’는 이날 “트럼프 쪽 인사들이 쿠팡과 한국의 갈등에 불을 지핀다”는 제목의 기사에서 미 공화당 인사들이 쿠팡을 방어하기 위해 나서고 있다고 보도했다. 이 매체는 쿠팡 사안에 정통하다는 관계자를 인용해 “제이미슨 그리어 미국 무역대표부(USTR) 대표가 쿠팡의 우려를 해결할 방안을 마련하기 위해 직접 노력하고 있다”고도 전했다. 또, 쿠팡이 ‘친트럼프 마가(MAGA)’ 성향의 로비스트 네트워크를 활용하기 시작하면서 미국에서 쿠팡을 돕자는 목소리가 커졌다고 보도했다.)

By Jang Ye-ji, Reporter penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Korean LNG Ship Bound for Pakistan Passes Through Strait of Hormuz (파키스탄행 한국 LNG선, 호르무즈해협 통과)
item.description:
Amid continued U.S. airstrikes on Iran even during ceasefire negotiations, a Korean vessel that had been stranded in the Strait of Hormuz escaped the strait on the 11th. This is the second Korean ship to pass through the Strait of Hormuz since the outbreak of the U.S.-Israel-Iran war, following the HMM Universal Winner last month. (휴전 협상 중에도 이란에 대한 미국의 공습이 계속되는 가운데, 호르무즈해협에 발이 묶였던 한국 선박 1척이 11일 해협을 빠져나왔다. 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 발발 뒤 한국 선박이 호르무즈해협을 통과한 건 지난달 에이치엠엠(HMM) 유니버설 위너호에 이어 두번째다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated on the same day, “A Korean ship is currently navigating through the Strait of Hormuz,” adding, “Discussions regarding this passage were led by the foreign charterer, and we understand the ship is heading to a third country, its final destination.” A charterer refers to a company that leases a vessel from its owner. The charterer that led the negotiations with the Iranian government is reported to be QatarEnergy, and the ship’s final destination is Pakistan. (외교부는 이날 “한국 선박 1척이 호르무즈해협을 통과해 항행 중”이라며 “이번 통항 관련 협의 등의 사항은 타국적 용선사 쪽에서 주도해 이뤄졌으며, 이 선박은 최종 목적지인 제3국으로 향하고 있는 것으로 알고 있다”고 밝혔다. 용선사는 선주에게 배를 빌려 사용하는 회사를 뜻한다. 이란 정부와 협의를 주도한 용선사는 ‘카타르에너지’이며, 선박의 최종 목적지는 파키스탄인 것으로 전해졌다.)

The vessel in question is a liquefied natural gas (LNG) carrier operated by a Korean shipping company and had been stranded while transporting natural gas to Pakistan. It is known to have eight Korean crew members on board. Pakistan, a country that has closely communicated with Iran and attempted mediation during this Middle Eastern conflict, appears to have facilitated the safe release of the ship based on its relationship with Iran. QatarEnergy is also continuously moving LNG carriers after consulting with Iran. (해당 선박은 한국 선사가 운용하는 액화천연가스(LNG) 운반선으로, 파키스탄에 천연가스를 운송하는 과정에서 발이 묶인 상태였다. 한국인 선원은 8명이 타고 있는 것으로 알려졌다. 파키스탄은 이번 중동 전쟁에서 이란과 긴밀하게 소통하며 중재를 시도했던 국가로, 이란과의 관계를 바탕으로 선박을 안전하게 빼낼 수 있던 것으로 보인다. 카타르에너지 또한 이란과 협의를 거쳐 지속적으로 액화천연가스 운반선들을 이동시키고 있다.)

This marks the first Korean ship to pass through the Strait of Hormuz in about 20 days since the Universal Winner departed on the 20th of last month following consultations between the Korean government and the Iranian government. The Universal Winner, carrying 2 million barrels of crude oil, arrived at Ulsan Port the day before. (한국 선박이 호르무즈해협을 통과한 건 우리 정부가 이란 정부와 협의해 지난달 20일 유니버설 위너호가 빠져나온 지 20여일 만이다. 원유 200만배럴을 실은 유니버설 위너호는 전날 울산항에 도착했다.)

The number of Korean ships stranded in the Strait of Hormuz has decreased to 24. The total number of Korean crew members in the strait, including those aboard foreign vessels, stands at 139. It remains unclear when the remaining ships might be able to exit the strait. As ceasefire negotiations stall, U.S. airstrikes near the strait have continued for a second day, and Iran declared a closure of the Strait of Hormuz on the same day. Although the Korean government is in communication with the Iranian government, there has reportedly been no progress regarding the passage of the ships. (호르무즈해협에 발이 묶인 한국 선박은 24척으로 줄었다. 해협 내 한국인 선원은 외국 선박에 승선 중인 인원을 포함해 모두 139명이다. 남은 선박이 언제쯤 해협을 빠져나올 수 있을지는 현재로선 불투명하다. 휴전 협상이 공전하면서 해협 인근을 향한 미국의 공습이 이틀째 계속되고, 이란은 이날 호르무즈해협 폐쇄를 선언했다. 우리 정부는 이란 정부와 소통하고는 있지만, 선박 통항과 관련한 진척은 없는 것으로 전해졌다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: South Korea and US Confirm "Shared Goal of North Korean Denuclearization"... 6th Nuclear Consultative Group Meeting (한미 “북한 비핵화 공동목표 확인”…6차 핵협의그룹 회의)
item.description:
South Korea and the United States held the 6th ROK-U.S. Nuclear Consultative Group (NCG) meeting on the 11th to reaffirm the goal of North Korean denuclearization and signed the NCG's security guidelines. (한미 양국이 11일 제6차 한미 핵협의그룹(NCG) 회의를 열어 북한 비핵화 목표를 재확인하고, 핵협의그룹의 보안지침에 서명했다.)

In a joint press statement released after the NCG meeting at the Ministry of National Defense in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, the two countries' defense ministries specified "North Korean denuclearization" as a shared goal. The statement said, "We decided to continuously develop NCG activities to strengthen the ROK-U.S. alliance and extended deterrence in a changing security environment where North Korea's nuclear and missile capabilities are advancing," adding, "South Korea and the US confirmed a shared goal of North Korea's denuclearization." The joint statement from the 5th meeting, which was the first held under the Lee Jae-myung administration, did not include the phrase "North Korea's denuclearization," but it was included this time. The two countries further stated, "The US side reaffirmed its commitment to provide extended deterrence to the Republic of Korea by utilizing all categories of US capabilities, including nuclear capabilities." (양국 국방부는 이날 서울 용산구 국방부에서 핵협의그룹 회의 뒤 발표한 공동언론성명에서 ‘북한 비핵화’를 공동 목표로 명시했다. 성명은 “북한의 핵·미사일 능력이 고도화되고, 변화하는 안보환경 속에서 한미동맹 및 확장억제를 강화하기 위해 한미 핵협의그룹 활동을 지속적으로 발전시켜 나가기로 했다”며 “한미는 북한의 비핵화에 대한 공동의 목표를 확인했다”고 밝혔다. 이재명 정부 들어 처음 열렸던 지난 5차 회의 공동성명엔 “북한의 비핵화” 표현이 없었는데, 이번에 포함된 것이다. 양국은 이어 “미국 쪽은 핵을 포함한 미국의 모든 범주의 능력을 활용하여 대한민국에 확장억제를 제공하는 공약을 재확인했다”고 덧붙였다.)

The meeting was co-chaired by Kim Hong-cheol, Director General for Defense Policy at the Ministry of National Defense, and Robert Soofer, Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense for Nuclear Deterrence, Chemical, Biological, and WMD Policy and Programs at the US Department of Defense, with officials from the defense, foreign affairs, and intelligence agencies of both countries in attendance. The meeting took place about six months after the 5th meeting was held in December last year. (회의는 김홍철 국방부 국방정책실장과 로버트 수퍼 미 전쟁부(국방부) 핵억제·화생방 정책 및 프로그램(WMD) 대응정책 부차관보 공동 주관으로 진행됐고 양국 국방·외교·정보 관계관들이 배석했다. 회의는 지난해 12월 5차 회의가 열린 뒤 6개월여 만에 열렸다.)

At this meeting, South Korea and the US also signed the "ROK-U.S. Nuclear Consultative Group Security Guidelines" to protect information needed for NCG activities and consultations. They reviewed tasks for the NCG, including such security and information sharing, consultation procedures in nuclear crises, integrated ROK-U.S. nuclear and conventional (CNI) exercises and training, strategic messaging, and risk reduction, and discussed various measures to strengthen the alliance's nuclear deterrence and readiness posture. (한미는 이번 회의에서 핵협의그룹 활동과 협의에 필요한 정보보호를 위한 ‘한미 핵협의그룹 보안지침’에도 서명했다. 이러한 보안과 정보공유, 핵위기 시 협의 절차, 한미 핵·재래식 통합(CNI) 연습과 훈련, 전략적 메시지 및 위험감소 등 핵협의그룹 추진 과업을 검토하고, 동맹의 핵억제와 대비 태세를 강화하기 위한 다양한 방안도 논의했다.)

ROK-U.S. nuclear and conventional integration is a concept where the US leads nuclear operations and South Korea supports them with conventional forces. At the 5th meeting, the two countries specified for the first time that "South Korea will play a leading role in conventional defense on the Korean Peninsula." The representatives of both sides agreed to report the results of this meeting to the ministers of the two countries at the 58th ROK-U.S. Security Consultative Meeting (SCM). They also approved the NCG's tasks and major activities for the latter half of this year, including plans to hold the 7th NCG plenary meeting. (한미 핵·재래식 통합은 미국이 핵작전을 주도하면 한국이 재래식 전력으로 이를 지원하는 개념이다. 지난 5차 회의에서 양국은 처음으로 “한국이 한반도 재래식 방위에 대한 주도적 역할을 수행해 나갈 것”이라고 명시했다. 한미 양쪽 대표는 이번 회의 결과를 제58차 한미안보협의회(SCM)에서 양국 장관에게 보고하기로 합의했다. 또 제7차 핵협의그룹 본회의 개최계획을 포함한 올해 후반기 핵협의그룹 추진과업과 주요활동을 승인했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Mourns Former Speaker Kono... "Kono Statement, Cornerstone of Korea-Japan Relations" (이 대통령, 고노 전 의장 애도…“고노 담화, 한일관계 주춧돌”)
item.description:
While on a state visit to Italy, President Lee Jae-myung expressed on the 11th (local time) regarding the passing of former House of Representatives Speaker Yohei Kono, who served as president of the Liberal Democratic Party, "I respectfully pray for the repose of the deceased and offer my deepest condolences to the bereaved family." (이탈리아를 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 11일(현지시각) 자민당 총재를 역임한 고노 요헤이 전 중의원 의장이 별세한 데 대해 “삼가 고인의 명복을 빌며, 유가족 여러분들께도 깊은 위로의 말씀을 전한다”고 말했다.)

President Lee stated on X (formerly Twitter) that day, "Former Speaker Kono, as a respected elder of Japanese politics, worked to build reconciliation and trust with neighboring countries and played a significant role in the development of Korea-Japan relations." He continued, "In particular, the 'Kono Statement' issued in 1993 was the first official document to acknowledge the historical fact that left 'deep wounds to the honor and dignity of many women' regarding the comfort women issue and to explicitly state 'heartfelt apologies and remorse.' At that time, through the Kono Statement, it also expressed the will to not turn away from historical facts but to face them as lessons and never repeat the same mistakes." <<> President Lee said, "The courage to reflect on history and the empathy for the pain of victims contained in the Kono Statement have become an important cornerstone for the development of a future-oriented relationship between Korea and Japan." He added, "While cherishing the achievements and noble intentions left by the deceased, I will continue to strive to develop a future-oriented Korea-Japan relationship based on mutual respect and trust." <<> Former Speaker Kono passed away the previous day at the age of 89. He was first elected in the 1967 House of Representatives election as a member of the Liberal Democratic Party, inheriting his father's constituency, and was subsequently re-elected 14 times consecutively. In 2003, he became Speaker of the House of Representatives and served for five and a half years before retiring without running in the 2009 election. <<> Rome/Correspondent Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr ( 이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “고노 전 의장님은 일본 정계의 존경받는 원로로서 이웃 국가들과의 화해와 신뢰 관계 구축에 힘쓰며 한일관계의 발전에도 큰 역할을 하셨다”며 “특히 1993년 발표한 ‘고노 담화’는 위안부 문제와 관련하여 ‘많은 여성들의 명예와 존엄에 깊은 상처’를 남긴 역사적 사실을 인정하고, ‘마음에서 우러나오는 사죄와 반성의 마음’을 명기한 최초의 공식 문서였다”고 말했다. 당시 고노담화를 통해 역사의 사실을 외면하지 않고 교훈으로 직시해 나가겠으며, 같은 잘못을 결코 되풀이하지 않겠다는 의지도 표명했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Korea-Italy relations upgraded to 'Special Strategic Partnership'... Expanding high-tech industry cooperation" (이 대통령 “한-이탈리아 ‘특별 전략적 동반자’로 격상…첨단산업 협력 확대”)
item.description:
During the Italy summit on the 11th (local time), President Lee Jae-myung stated, "We have agreed to elevate bilateral relations to a 'Special Strategic Partnership' to reflect our determination to develop cooperation between the two countries more dynamically." (이재명 대통령이 11일(현지시각) 이탈리아 정상회담을 통해 “양국 간 협력을 더 역동적으로 발전시키겠다는 의지를 담아, 양국 관계를 ‘특별 전략적 동반자 관계’로 격상하기로 합의했다”고 말했다.)

In a joint press conference following the summit held at the Quirinal Palace in Rome, the President said, "Based on the trust and bonds accumulated so far, as well as the values shared by both countries, we will open a new chapter of cooperation toward shared prosperity." The two countries upgraded their bilateral ties from the 'Strategic Partnership' established in 2018 to a 'Special Strategic Partnership' on the occasion of this summit. This marks President Lee's first state visit to Europe since his administration took office, and it is also the first state visit by a South Korean president to Italy in 26 years since former President Kim Dae-jung. (이 대통령은 이날 로마 대통령궁에서 열린 정상회담 뒤 공동언론발표에서 “그간 축적된 신뢰와 유대, 양국이 공유하는 가치를 바탕으로 공동번영을 향한 새로운 협력의 장을 열어나갈 것”이라고 말했다. 양국은 2018년 수립한 ‘전략적 동반자 관계’를 이번 정상회담을 계기로 ‘특별 전략적 동반자 관계’로 한 단계 격상했다. 이 대통령이 정부 출범 이후 유럽을 국빈 방문한 것은 이번이 처음이다. 김대중 전 대통령 이후 26년 만에 우리 국가 정상의 이탈리아 국빈방문이기도 하다.)

President Lee stated, "We will further develop trade and investment cooperation between the two countries in a mutually beneficial manner and work together for the stable business activities of companies from both nations." He added, "In particular, the 'Memorandum of Understanding on SME Cooperation' and the 'Memorandum of Understanding on Social Solidarity Economy Cooperation' signed this time will become an important foundation for identifying practical support measures for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and small business owners, as well as revitalizing the social solidarity economy ecosystem in both countries." Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong and Hyosung Group Chairman Cho Hyun-joon are expected to attend the 'Korea-Italy Business Round Table' to be held in Rome on the 12th. (이 대통령은 “양국 간 교역·투자 협력을 더욱 호혜적으로 발전시키고, 양국 기업의 안정적 경영 활동을 위해 함께 노력하겠다”며 “특히 이번에 체결되는 ‘중소기업 협력 양해각서’와 ‘사회연대경제 협력 양해각서’는 중소기업·소상공인을 위한 실질적인 지원책을 발굴하고, 양국 사회연대경제 생태계를 활성화하는 중요한 기반이 될 것”이라고 말했다. 12일 로마에서 열리는 ‘한-이탈리아 비즈니스 라운드 테이블’에는 이재용 삼성전자 회장과 조현준 효성 회장 등이 참석할 예정이다.)

Furthermore, the two countries agreed to further expand future-oriented cooperation in high-tech industries and science and technology. President Lee stated, "The 'Memorandum of Understanding on Advanced Science and Technology and ICT Cooperation' adopted this time will serve as an institutional foundation to further advance the partnership between the two countries in national strategic technology fields such as artificial intelligence, quantum industry, sixth-generation mobile communication, and advanced biotechnology." (또 첨단산업 및 과학기술 분야에서 양국의 미래지향적인 협력을 더욱 확대하기로 했다. 이 대통령은 “이번에 채택하는 ‘첨단 과학기술 및 정보통신기술(ICT) 협력에 관한 양해각서‘는 인공지능, 양자산업, 6세대 이동통신, 첨단바이오 등 국가 전략기술 분야에서 양국의 파트너십을 더욱 고도화할 제도적 기반이 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

In addition, they agreed to cooperate on energy security, which has been exacerbated by the prolonged war involving the United States, Israel, and Iran. President Lee said, "Having experienced supply chain crises stemming from the recent Middle East conflicts, we keenly feel the need for cooperation among allied countries." He added, "Korea and Italy will work closely together, promoting energy security and supply chain stability through close communication and collaboration." (아울러 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 장기화로 인한 에너지 안보에 대해서 협력을 해 나가기로 했다. 이 대통령은 “최근 중동 전쟁에서 비롯된 공급망 위기를 겪으며, 우리는 우방국 간 공조의 필요성을 절실히 체감하고 있다”며 “한·이탈리아 양국은 에너지 안보와 공급망 안정을 함께 도모하며 긴밀히 소통하고 협력해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

Regarding issues on the Korean Peninsula, President Lee stated, "I informed President Mattarella about our vision for peaceful coexistence and shared growth on the Korean Peninsula." He added, "The President highly appreciated our government's willingness for dialogue and cooperation and responded that we would work together for peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula." (이 대통령은 한반도 문제와 관련해선 “저는 마타렐라 대통령께 한반도 평화공존과 공동 성장을 위한 구상에 대해 말씀드렸다”며 “대통령님께서는 우리 정부의 대화와 협력 의지를 높이 평가하며, 한반도 평화와 안정을 위해 함께 노력하겠다고 화답해 주셨다”고 말했다.)

Rome / Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (로마/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Tries to Manage with “Unity,” but Calls for “Immediate Resignation” Erupt at Party Meeting (정청래 “단결” 수습 나섰지만…의총서 “당장 사퇴” 분출)
item.description:
At the first general meeting of Democratic Party lawmakers following the June 3 local elections, calls for Representative Jung Cheong-rae to resign from his leadership position erupted. Criticism also continued regarding the responsibility for the defeat in the Seoul mayoral election, as well as the rough and inadequate management of the candidate nomination process. (6·3 지방선거 뒤 처음으로 열린 더불어민주당 의원총회에서 정청래 대표를 향한 대표직 사퇴 요구가 분출했다. 서울시장 선거 패배에 대한 책임론과 함께 공천 과정 관리가 거칠고 미흡했다는 비판도 이어졌다.)

At the Democratic Party lawmakers’ meeting, which lasted about 1 hour and 10 minutes at the National Assembly on the 11th, several attendees demanded Representative Jung resign. Lawmaker Jang Cheol-min said in a Facebook post, “For genuine unity and to consolidate party strength after the national convention, you must resign, even today. This applies not only to Representative Jung but also to all those responsible for managing the national convention election.” (11일 국회에서 1시간10분가량 열린 민주당 의원총회에서 여러 참석자들은 정 대표에게 사퇴를 요구했다. 장철민 의원은 “진정으로 통합하고 전당대회 이후 당력을 결집하려면, 오늘이라도 사퇴해야 한다. 정 대표뿐만 아니라 전당대회 선거 관리의 책임을 갖고 있는 분들 모두 마찬가지”라고 말했다고 페이스북을 통해 밝혔다.)

Lawmaker Lim Mi-ae reportedly stated, “In 2024, Representative Lee Jae-myung resigned, and the election was held within 60 days, and in 2010, Representative Chung Sye-kyun resigned two months before the convention,” adding, “It is necessary to demonstrate a will to fairly manage the national convention by resigning from the leadership.” This was a strong urging to resign immediately to show commitment to a fair national convention. (임미애 의원도 “2024년 이재명 대표 사퇴 후 60일 안에 선거를 했고, 2010년 정세균 대표는 (전대) 두달 전에 사퇴했다”며 “전당대회를 공정하게 관리하겠다는 의지를 (대표직 사퇴로) 보여주는 것이 필요하다”고 말한 것으로 전해졌다. 공정한 전당대회에 대한 의지를 보이려면 즉시 사퇴하라고 촉구한 것이다.)

Lawmaker Shin Jeong-hoon pointed out issues in the internal public opinion polling process for selecting candidates in the Honam region local elections. He reportedly made remarks suggesting that independent candidates performed unexpectedly well “due to the Democratic Party’s arrogant attitude toward Honam.” Lawmaker Jeong Il-young, whose constituency is Yeonsu-gu, Incheon, reportedly commented that an unqualified candidate was nominated for the Yeonsu-gu district office head election, leading to defeat, and stressed that “we must be humble.” (신정훈 의원은 호남권 지방선거 후보를 결정하기 위한 당내 여론조사 과정의 문제점을 지적했다. 그는 “호남에 대한 민주당의 오만한 자세 때문”에 무소속 후보들이 예상 외의 선전을 했다는 취지의 발언을 했다고 한다. 인천 연수을이 지역구인 정일영 의원은 부적격한 후보가 연수구청장 후보로 공천돼 선거에서 패배했다며 “겸손해야 한다”는 취지의 발언을 했다.)

In response, some voices opposed the blame on Representative Jung or emphasized unity. Lawmaker Choi Min-hee reportedly countered claims of a “major defeat” within the party, saying, “In terms of numbers (for metropolitan mayoral elections), 12 to 4 is indeed a victory.” Lawmaker Kim Young-bae reportedly stated, “This isn’t something that can be resolved by shouting and pointing fingers at each other. Properly evaluating the local elections is necessary to come up with alternatives.” (이에 맞서 정 대표 책임론에 반대하거나 통합을 강조하는 목소리도 나왔다. 최민희 의원은 “(광역단체장 선거) 12 대 4 숫자로는 승리한 것이 맞다”며 당내 일각의 ‘대패’ 주장을 반박했다고 한다. 김영배 의원은 “서로 소리를 지르고 삿대질을 한다고 될 문제가 아니다. 지방선거 평가를 제대로 해야 대안이 마련된다”고 말한 것으로 전해졌다.)

Representative Jung did not give any specific response to the demands for his resignation from some lawmakers. In his opening remarks before the lawmakers’ full-fledged statements began, he called for internal unity, saying, “Throughout history, we have won when united and lost when divided.” After referencing President Lee Jae-myung’s past comment that “While politics may seem like something politicians do, it is ultimately done by the people,” Representative Jung added, “President Lee often emphasized internal unity.” (정 대표는 일부 의원들의 사퇴 요구에 별다른 답을 하지 않았다. 정 대표는 의원들의 본격적인 발언이 시작되기 전 회의 머리발언에서는 “우리는 역사 속에서 단결하며 승리했고 분열하면 패배했다”며 내부 단결을 주문했다. 또 ‘정치는 정치인이 하는 것 같지만, 결국 국민이 한다’는 이재명 대통령의 과거 발언을 언급한 뒤 “이 대통령은 내부 단결을 강조하는 말을 자주 했다”고 했다.)

At a symposium hosted by the Democratic Research Institute and the party’s policy committee titled “One Year of the Lee Jae-myung Government,” Representative Jung flattered President Lee, stating, “President Lee’s very existence has become a constant in South Korea’s national competitiveness.” This remark seemed to be a response to backlash from non-mainstream factions, following his earlier comment at the Supreme Council meeting that “no regime can win against the people. The people are eternal, and regimes are temporary.” (정 대표는 민주연구원과 당 정책위원회가 주최한 ‘이재명 정부 1년’ 토론회에선 “이 대통령 존재 자체가 대한민국 국가 경쟁력의 상수로 자리 잡았다”며 이 대통령을 추어올렸다. 정 대표의 이런 발언은 전날 최고위원회의에서 “국민 이기는 정권은 없다. 국민은 영원하고 정권은 짧다”고 말한 뒤 비당권파를 중심으로 ‘청와대와 각을 세우는 것이냐’는 반발을 의식한 것으로 보인다.)

On this day, Representative Jung actively refuted criticism from lawmakers like Kim Nam-hee and Jeon Hyun-hee, who had pointed out that the party’s one-member-one-vote system—which Jung had actively introduced—was causing a disconnect from public sentiment. Representative Jung wrote on Facebook, “The one-member-one-vote system is democracy itself. Democracy must be protected.” (이날 정 대표는 최근 김남희·전현희 의원 등이 정 대표가 적극적으로 도입한 권리당원 1인 1표제로 인해 당이 민심과 괴리되고 있다는 취지의 지적을 내놓는 것에 대해선 적극 반박했다. 정 대표는 페이스북에 “1인 1표제는 민주주의 그 자체”라며 “민주주의는 지켜져야 한다”고 썼다.)

item.title: Han Sung-sook declares assets worth 25 billion won... 2 houses, 10.3 billion won in deposits, 2 billion won in stocks (한성숙, 재산 250억원 신고…집 2채·예금 103억·주식 20억)
item.description:
Prime Minister nominee Han Sung-sook has declared total assets of 25.3901 billion won, including those in her name and her mother's. (한성숙 국무총리 후보자가 본인과 어머니 명의 재산으로 모두 253억9010만6000원을 신고했다.)

According to the confirmation hearing request submitted to the National Assembly on the 11th, Han's personal assets amount to 25.00882 billion won, comprising real estate worth 3.06648 billion won, deposits of 10.32387 billion won, and stocks of 2.06583 billion won. This is an increase of 2.70725 billion won from the 22.30157 billion won declared at the end of last year. (11일 국회에 제출된 한 후보자 인사청문요청안을 보면, 한 후보자 본인 명의 재산은 부동산 30억6648만원과 예금 103억2387만원, 주식 20억6583만원 등 250억882만원이다. 지난해 말 기준 신고액 223억157만원보다 27억725만원 늘었다.)

Han is a multi-homeowner with two houses: a standalone house in Samcheong-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul (1.5 billion won), and a standalone house in Yangseo-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun, Gyeonggi Province (630 million won). She also owns a 1/10 share (6.97 million won) of a standalone house in Gwangsadong, Yangju-si, Gyeonggi Province. Among the homes she declared as assets last year, she sold an apartment in Jamsil-dong, Songpa-gu, Seoul, reportedly making a profit of nearly 3 billion won after 20 years of ownership. (한 후보자는 서울 종로구 삼청동 단독주택(15억원)과 경기 양평군 양서면 단독주택(6억3천만원) 등 주택 2채를 보유한 다주택자다. 경기 양주시 광사동 단독주택의 지분 10분의 1(697만원)도 가지고 있다. 한 후보자는 지난해 재산으로 신고했던 주택 가운데 서울 송파구 잠실동 아파트는 팔았는데, 구매 20년 만에 약 30억원에 가까운 차익을 남긴 것으로 전해졌다.)

Apart from houses, Han declared ownership of an officetel in Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul (approximately 2.07463 billion won), a neighborhood living facility in Yeongeon-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul (approximately 1.4 billion won), a second-class neighborhood living facility (approximately 890 million won), land in Yangseo-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun, Gyeonggi Province, and land in Gwangsadong, Yangju-si, Gyeonggi Province. (한 후보자는 주택 외 부동산으로는 서울 강남구 역삼동 오피스텔(약 20억7463만원), 서울 종로구 연건동 근린생활시설(약 14억원)·제2종근린생활시설(약 8억9천만원), 경기 양평군 양서면 일대 토지와 경기 양주시 광사동 일대 토지를 갖고 있다고 신고했다.)

Her stocks were mostly foreign stocks and exchange-traded funds (ETFs), including Tesla (approximately 1.29457 billion won), Apple (approximately 420 million won), Palantir (approximately 120.15 million won), and Nvidia (approximately 146.09 million won). Additionally, Han declared a leasehold on an apartment in Naesu-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul (1.85 billion won), government bonds (3.090552 billion won), private bonds (345 million won), and a 2011 Kia Sportage (1995cc). (주식은 테슬라(약 12억9457만원), 애플(약 4억2천만원), 팔란티어(약 1억2015만원), 엔비디아(약 1억4609만원) 등 해외 주식과 상장지수펀드(ETF)가 대부분이었다. 한 후보자는 이 밖에도 서울 종로구 내수동 아파트 전세권(18억5천만원)과 국채(30억9055만2천원), 사인 간 채권(3억4500만원), 2011년식 기아 스포티지(1995㏄) 등을 신고했다.)

Han's mother declared total assets of 381.283 million won, including land in Gwangsadong, Yangju-si, Gyeonggi Province (approximately 329 million won) and deposits. (한 후보자의 어머니는 경기 양주시 광사동 토지(약 3억2900만원)와 예금 등 총 3억8128만3000원의 재산을 신고했다.)

Regarding Han's criminal record, in 2006, while serving as the head of the search service division at the portal site Empas, she was fined 10 million won and ordered forfeiture for violating the Information and Communications Network Act (distribution of obscene material). At the time, prosecutors indicted dozens of people, including Han, claiming that adult content provided by the portal site was massively distributing obscene materials. On the 8th, Han's confirmation preparation team stated, "This was a case where representatives of internet portal services were all prosecuted and punished in 2005. At the time, as the overall head of Empas's search service, the nominee was punished, but it is not true that she directly posted obscene material." (한 후보자의 범죄 이력을 보면, 포털사이트 엠파스의 검색서비스본부장으로 있던 2006년 정보통신망법 위반(음란물유포 등)으로 벌금 1천만원과 몰수형을 선고받았다. 당시 검찰은 포털사이트가 제공하는 성인 콘텐츠가 음란물을 대량 유포하고 있다며 수십명을 기소했는데, 당시 한 후보자도 포함됐다. 한 후보자 인사청문준비단 지난 8일 “2005년 인터넷 포털 서비스 대표자들이 고발당하여 모두 처분을 받은 건으로, 당시 후보자는 엠파스 검색서비스 전체 책임자로서 처벌을 받은 바 있으나, 직접 음란물을 게시했다는 것은 사실이 아니다”는 입장을 냈다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Min-seok: "Infringement of Suffrage Is Unacceptable... Zero Tolerance for Destruction of Democratic Order" (김민석 “참정권 침해 용납 안돼…민주 질서 파괴엔 무관용 대응”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 11th regarding the "ballot shortage incident," "While the infringement of suffrage is unacceptable, I also believe that the violation of democratic order must not be tolerated." (김민석 국무총리가 11일 ‘투표용지 부족사태’와 관련해 “참정권 침해도 용납할 수 없는 일이지만 민주질서 침해 또한 용납되어선 안 된다 생각한다”고 말했다.)

At a meeting of ministers related to the infringement of citizens' suffrage held at the Government Complex Sejong in Sejong City, Prime Minister Kim said, "By what right do they block citizens' free movement or access, detain police officers, and slander and hurl insults at passing citizens? Who has the right to do such things?" (김 총리는 이날 세종시 정부세종청사에서 열린 국민참정권 침해 관련 관계장관회의에서 “무슨 권리로 시민들의 자유로운 통행이나 출입을 막고 경찰관들을 감금하고 또 지나가는 시민을 비방하고 욕설하고 그렇게 할 권리가 누구에게 있냐”며 이같이 말했다.)

This was a criticism of problematic actions by some participants who have been blocking the entrance to the Handball Stadium at Olympic Park in Songpa-gu for a week and holding protest rallies, including stopping female youth national handball team players from entering and searching their belongings. On that day, some protesters also blocked a press conference by employees of resident sports organizations trying to enter the stadium and hurled abusive language and threats at the press. (이는 일주일째 송파구 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장 입구를 봉쇄하고 규탄 시위를 벌이는 참가자 가운데 일부가 핸드볼 여성 유소년 국가대표 선수들의 출입을 막고 소지품을 뒤지는 등 문제 행동을 이어가는 것에 대해 지적한 것이다. 이날 일부 시위 참가자들은 경기장에 진입하려는 입주 체육단체 직원들의 기자회견을 가로막고 취재진에게 욕설과 폭언을 쏟아내기도 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim said, "Exploiting the public demand to protect democracy to instead destroy democratic order and democracy is absolutely unacceptable," adding, "I ask relevant ministries to respond with the principle of zero tolerance, thoroughly investigating to ensure such acts never happen." He continued, "Responsibility must be taken for the infringement of suffrage, but responsibility must also be taken for the violation of democratic order. The government will humbly accept legitimate questions and discussions, but will respond strictly and consistently to anti-democratic behavior that causes inconvenience to citizens." (김 총리는 “민주주의를 지켜야 한다는 국민 요구를 악용해서 오히려 민주질서와 민주주의를 파괴하려는 행위는 절대로 용납될 수 없다”며 “무관용의 원칙으로 끝까지 파악하고 절대로 그런 일이 이뤄질 수 없도록 해야 한다는 생각으로 관련 부처는 대응해달라”고 말했다. 그는 “참정권 침해에 대해서도 책임져야 하지만 민주질서 침해도 반드시 책임을 져야 할 것”이라며 “정부는 정당한 문제제기와 논의에 대해서는 겸허한 자세로 수용하겠지만 시민들에게 불편을 끼치는 반민주적 행태에 대해서는 끝까지 원칙적으로 대응하겠다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the National Election Commission, which has revealed comprehensive disarray, Prime Minister Kim said, "If this is the case, wouldn't it be better to dissolve the commission? There must be voices from the public saying the commission should be dissolved if it operates like this." He added, "I believe a thorough awakening is needed from the top to the bottom." (김 총리는 총체적 난맥상이 드러나고 있는 중앙선거관리위원회에 대해서도 “이럴 거면 선관위는 차라리 해체하는 게 낫지 않나, 선관위가 이런 식이면 해체돼야 한다는 국민 목소리가 틀림없이 있다”고 말했다. 그는 “정말 위부터 아래까지 대오각성해야 한다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

Addressing the National Assembly, Prime Minister Kim said, "Beyond factions or political interests, I ask the ruling and opposition parties to quickly discuss forming a special committee to strengthen democracy, lead a thorough investigation into the truth, and discuss institutional improvements. The government will actively cooperate in all necessary areas." (김 총리는 국회를 향해서도 “정파나 정치적 이해관계를 떠나 여야가 민주주의 공고화를 위해 특위 구성을 신속하게 협의해주시고 철저한 진상규명과 제도개선 논의를 이끌어주시기 바란다”며 “정부도 필요한 모든 부분 적극 협력하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Ko Gyeong-ju goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)
